rationale: C21 provides an unmistakable two-section drafting template for the child's first two sections: designation of an agency to conduct statutorily required investigations and written reports concerning specified attributes of persons seeking admission, followed by an interagency-assistance provision using nearly identical language and machinery. The child adapts that framework from the Displaced Persons Act to the Refugee Relief Act and substitutes the Department of State as the responsible agency. C14 contains essentially the same template but is weaker because C21 is the later, superseding version. C05 also plausibly contributed wording to the child's separate Bureau of the Budget delegation, but it is less central than the investigation-and-assistance template.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Department of State is designated as the agency ... which shall, subject to the provisions of section 2 hereof, make or prepare the thorough investigations and written reports required by section 11 (a) ... regarding the character, reputation, mental and physical health, history, and eligibility ... of persons seeking admission into the United States
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Displaced Persons Commission is hereby designated as the agency which shall, subject to the provisions of paragraph 2 hereof, make or prepare the investigations and written reports required by sections 10 and 12 ... regarding the character, history, and eligibility ... of ... persons ... seeking admission into the United States.
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive shared language and the same statutory-investigation machinery, adapted to a new agency, statute, and expanded list of investigative subjects.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Department of the Army and such other agencies of the Government as the Department of State may request shall, in accordance with arrangements agreed upon between the Department of State and any such agency, furnish the Department of State such assistance as it may need in carrying out its responsibilities under section 1 of this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Department of State, the Department of the Army, and such other agencies of the Government as the Displaced Persons Commission may request, shall, in accordance with arrangements agreed upon between the Commission and any such department or agency, furnish the Commission such assistance as it may need in carrying out its responsibilities under paragraph 1 of this order.
shared_material.explanation: Near-verbatim interagency-assistance clause occupying the same position and serving the same function; the Department of State is removed from the assisting-agency list because it becomes the responsible agency in the child.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Director of the Bureau of the Budget is authorized and empowered to exercise the authority conferred upon the President by the paragraph appearing under the aforesaid heading "Emergency Migration"
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Director of the Bureau of the Budget is hereby authorized and empowered to exercise the authority vested in the President by the paragraph appearing under the heading "Funds Appropriated to the President—Expenses of Management Improvement" in Chapter VII of the Supplemental Appropriation Act, 1954
shared_material.explanation: C05 offers a close literal and legal-delegation formula for the child's section 4, though this is a secondary contribution relative to C21's extensive template.
